physicalNotes: Radius 1.01034 solar radii from TICv8, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract): 702,894 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.04 solar masses from TICv8, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5781 +/- 85 K from TICv8, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-17 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
